about.title: Making sense of data and turning it into something useful.
about.intro: I am a Computer Science and Data Engineering student at ENSA Khouribga, particularly interested in Data Analysis and Business Intelligence (BI). My projects, including the GTM dashboard, have given me early hands-on practice analyzing data and presenting indicators. I am building my Data Engineering foundations and remain open to Data Science and Machine Learning.
about.search: I am seeking an internship starting July 2027, where data and software can help solve a concrete problem.

about.galaxyText: As an individual professional project, I designed GTM, a training-management application. It brings together a web interface, database, user roles, dashboard, and analytical features to make training activity easier to follow.
about.cestomText: As secretary general, I contribute to coordinating the Khouribga section and following up with its members.

cestomResponsibilities.followUp: Follow up with members and contribute to coordinating the section.

understand.title: Understand
understand.text: I start with the problem, available data, and constraints. The CA project in particular led me to revisit the method’s mechanics before coding them.

analyze.title: Analyse
analyze.text: I check and structure what exists before drawing conclusions. The Olist audit is where this step takes the most space.

build.title: Build
build.text: I turn that understanding into a tangible output: an interface, an analysis, or a tool. GTM brings these dimensions together in one application.

verify.title: Check before concluding
verify.text: Olist consistency checks and GTM validation steps are part of the work, not just its presentation.

method.title: Understand the method
method.text: For CA, the calculations were rebuilt step by step with Pandas, NumPy, and SciPy instead of being treated as a black box.

progress.title: Keep learning
progress.text: Data Analysis and BI guide my interests; my analysis projects and the GTM dashboard offer practical examples. I am developing my Data Engineering foundations and remain open to Data Science and Machine Learning.

about.focusText: Data Analysis and BI shape my interests, grounded in practical analysis and dashboard projects. I am developing my Data Engineering foundations and remain curious about Data Science and Machine Learning.
about.beyondText: I also learn through collaborative projects and practical technical challenges. Community involvement such as CESTOM complements this path through teamwork and real-world use of digital tools.
